display_long_description:
The Climb Adventure is a fun VR climbing adventure game designed for casual players and families who want to experience the thrill of heights in virtual reality. 

Compete with players around the world and prove your skills on the global leaderboard.


Features:
• 5 unique mountains: Alps, glaciers, desert, beach, and volcanic crater
• Arcade-style VR climbing gameplay
[media]


• Global leaderboard and achievements
• Fragile and dangerous rocks that challenge your timing
[media]

• Slippery and dusty rocks.
[media]

• Natural obstacles like bushes and terrain hazards
[media]

• Ziplines for fast and strategic movement
[media]

• Hidden collectibles like bird eggs at extreme heights

Climb higher, improve your skills, and become one of the best VR climbers.
